Observation: - The Really Nasty Horse Racing Game: The Really Nasty Horse Racing Game is a board game for 2-6 players, published by Crown & Andrews and designed by Peter Hawes. The game is a simulation of a horse race, where players bet on horses and try to manipulate the outcome of the race.
